captions.title: Moving without collisions
captions.body: Task: move the red cube onto the green pad

captions.title: No obstacle
captions.body: Blue dots trace the gripper while it carries the cube: a low, direct path

captions.title: Now add a wall
captions.body: The robot knows the wall's shape and checks every move for collisions

captions.title: A new path
captions.body: The yellow path lifts the cube up and over the wall

captions.title: Same task, different route
captions.body: Collision checking changes HOW the robot moves, not WHAT it does
